2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) The terms and conditions for hiring of 01 housekeeping and sanitation personne l are decided as below:- 1. Service provider’s registered address must be at Chandrapur, Maharsahtra. D ocumentary evidence (Official address of Enterprise as per MSME/UDYAM Certifi cate) is to be submitted. 2. Bidder should have valid MSME Certificate, NSIC Certificate, UDYAM Certificat e, ATC certificate and ISO 9001 Certificate. Documentary evidence is to be sub mitted. 3. Bidder should have PF registration, ESIC registration, PT registration and GST registration. Documentary evidence is to be submitted. 4. PAN card and Average Annual Turnover for the last 3 years (F.Y. 2023-24, F.Y. 2024-2025 and F.Y. 2025-26) duly certified by a Chartered Accountant 5. Bidder should have minimum 01 Year of valid Experience Certificate of work i n Income Tax Department (Work order will not be considered). Documentary evi dence is to be submitted. 6. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proc eedings should not be bankrupt. Bidder is to upload undertaking to this effect w ith bid. 7. Bidder should not be blacklisted. Bidder is to upload undertaking to this effec t with bid. 8. Bidder should have Maharashtra Government Labour license/ Labour registrat ion for providing housekeeping and sanitation services. Documentary evidence i s to be submitted. 9. Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the certificat es / documents sought in the bid document. 10. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regard. GST reimbursement will be as per actual or as per applicable rates (Whichever is lower), subject to the max imum of quoted GST%. 11. Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 6 months beyond th e initial contract duration (subject to satisfactory performance and mutual cons ent). 12. Payment of salary and wages: Service provider is required to pay salaries/w ages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and th en claim payment from buyer along with all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC, PT etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 13. While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned cop y of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 14. Office of the Addl./Jt. CIT (VU)-1(1), Chandrapur, reserves the right to reject any or all bids without assigning any reason whatsoever.
